title: Whitehorse shelter operator denies wrongdoing in 2023 death of resident | CBC News
body: February 27, 2026 - The Connective Support Society is denying all accusations of negligence in the death of Josephine Hager at the Whitehorse Emergency Shelter in 2023.

title: Letter from Chief Coroner to Connective Support Society regarding Whitehorse Emergency Shelter Inquest | Yukon.ca
body: May 27, 2024 - A letter sent from the Chief Coroner to Connective Support Society, regarding the recommendations in response to the Whitehorse Emergency Shelter Inquest.

title: Father of woman who died at Whitehorse Emergency Shelter files lawsuit against Connective, employees | CBC News
body: October 18, 2025 - The father of a woman who died at the Whitehorse Emergency Shelter in 2023 has filed a lawsuit against the organization that runs the facility, alleging its negligence, and that of its staff, led to her death.

title: Person dies while visiting permanent housing unit at Whitehorse emergency shelter | CBC News
body: October 2, 2024 - A person visiting a permanent supportive housing unit at the Whitehorse Emergency Shelter died on-site on Monday. Connective, the B.C.-based NGO that operates the shelter, confirmed the death in an emailed statement Tuesday.

title: Yukon Coroner's Service investigating death at Whitehorse shelter housing unit | CBC News
body: March 29, 2025 - The Yukon Coroner's Service is investigating after a person visiting a housing unit above the Whitehorse emergency shelter died Thursday. Chief Coroner Heather Jones confirmed in an email that the death was reported to the service but wrote ...

title: Whitehorse shelter operator responds to another lawsuit alleging negligence | CBC News
body: March 5, 2026 - The Connective Support Society and Yukon government both say they're not responsible for the death of Leonard Capot-Blanc, who died at the Whitehorse Emergency Shelter in 2024.

title: New lawsuit filed by family of man who died at Whitehorse shelter in December 2024 | CBC News
body: December 19, 2025 - Capot-Blanc was one of two people to die at the shelter in December 2024. The lawsuit accuses the Connective Support Society and the government of failing to stop preventable deaths.

title: Whitehorse Emergency Shelter overdose death prompts new lawsuit alleging systemic failures | Yukon News
body: December 31, 2025 - The step‑daughter of a Whitehorse Emergency Shelter resident claims in a lawsuit that his death there was the result of systemic negligence and ignored warnings about overdose risks on the part of the Yukon government and the contractor that runs the shelter on their behalf.
